name: ai-gateway
description: Free-API-first AI gateway for Cloudflare Workers: aggregate many free API keys into one stable endpoint with node-local cooldowns, tier fallback, and circuit-breaker recovery.

scripts.test: node scripts/nodes-shard-test.mjs && node scripts/reliability-unit-test.mjs && node scripts/integration-test.mjs

scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run check:deploy
